state_machine.description: Stopped. Waits for a valid start rising edge with sensor1 TRUE.
Conveyor runs toward target; arrival at target stops motion and latches currentStation.
Stopped at processing station 2-4, waiting for a fresh matching completion rising edge.

state_machine.guard: startRise && sensor1 && processLength in 1..8 && processSequence[processLength] = 5 && processSequence[1] <> 1

state_machine.actions: no state change; outputs remain stopped
sequenceIndex := sequenceIndex + 1; target := processSequence[sequenceIndex]; require a new completion rising edge

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No IEC timers are required. Instance reset clears all retained edge-history bits and resets phase/currentStation/sequenceIndex/target/outputs to initial values.
timer_plan.stage3_note: Stage 3 is a no-op for timers. If a watchdog or debounce TON/TOF is added later, its FB call must be unconditional and top-level in stage 3, outside CASE/IF.

safety: conveyorLeft and conveyorRight are mutually exclusive; both FALSE whenever stopped.
Destination arrival immediately forces stop and prevents completion acceptance in the same scan.
Completion edges are accepted only in WAIT_PROCESS for the matching current station 2-4; at most one sequence advancement per scan.
Start is accepted only in IDLE with rising station1Start AND sensor1 TRUE; otherwise remain stopped.
A same-station next target after completion remains WAIT_PROCESS and requires a new completion rising edge.
operational: Direction is determined from target versus currentStation; equal target/current means no movement.
Station 5 arrival terminates the active sequence and returns to IDLE.
processSequence and processLength are treated as fixed and valid during a product cycle, with final active entry 5.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample all inputs into scan shadow values. Compute startRise := station1Start && !prevStation1Start; comp2Rise := station2Complete && !prevStation2Complete; comp3Rise := station3Complete && !prevStation3Complete; comp4Rise := station4Complete && !prevStation4Complete. Update prev bits to current input values at end of stage. Define sensorAt(s) using sensor1..sensor5.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Apply reset if requested. Enforce safety priorities before normal transitions: do not start unless IDLE && startRise && sensor1; ignore completion unless WAIT_PROCESS and freshMatchingCompletion; do not move on arrival. Execute the state-machine transitions using post-entry phase and one advancement maximum.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: No timer FBs are instantiated. Any future timer FB must be called here unconditionally, not inside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Default conveyorLeft := FALSE and conveyorRight := FALSE. If post-phase = MOVING and NOT sensorAt(target): set conveyorRight := TRUE when target > currentStation; set conveyorLeft := TRUE when target < currentStation; otherwise both remain FALSE. No other code writes outputs.
